name: table-th-tool
description: WordPress plugin to convert table cells between TH and TD elements

scripts.zip: npm run build && rm -rf dist table-th-tool.zip && mkdir -p dist/table-th-tool && cp -r index.php table-th-tool.php readme.txt build assets languages dist/table-th-tool/ && cd dist && zip -r ../table-th-tool.zip table-th-tool && cd .. && rm -rf dist && echo 'Created: table-th-tool.zip'
scripts.env:start: docker info > /dev/null 2>&1 || (open -a Docker && echo 'Docker起動中...' && until docker info > /dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 2; done && echo 'Docker準備完了') && docker-compose up -d && echo '\nWordPress: http://localhost:8082'
scripts.plugin-check: docker exec table-th-tool-wp bash -c 'cd /var/www/html && php wp-cli.phar plugin check table-th-tool --require=./wp-content/plugins/plugin-check/cli.php --allow-root --ignore-codes=outdated_tested_upto_header,hidden_files,ai_instruction_directory,github_directory,compressed_files 2>&1'
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run plugin-check && playwright test
scripts.test:full: npm run env:start && npm run test
